heading: Who we are and what we stand for
background: DESS began in response to the challenge of unreliable electricity in Nigeria, and grew as customers asked for more. Today, Dabo Energy & Security Solutions is a technology and systems solutions company providing energy, security, connectivity, maintenance and technical consultation services.

We operate from Kano and Nasarawa, serving both Nasarawa and Abuja from our Mararaba base, and accept enquiries across Nigeria. With 8+ years of experience, we approach every job the same way: understand the problem, recommend a practical solution, install and configure it properly, and keep supporting it.

expertise.title: CCTV and security systems
expertise.text: Design, installation, configuration and remote viewing setup, plus fault-finding on existing systems.

expertise.title: Solar and backup power
expertise.text: Assessment-led design, equipment selection, installation, configuration and support.

expertise.title: Maintenance and troubleshooting
expertise.text: Inspection, repairs where applicable, optimisation, upgrades and technical support.

expertise.title: Technical consultation
expertise.text: Honest guidance on the right solution before you buy equipment or start installation.

expertise.title: Starlink and connectivity
expertise.text: Installation, activation help, Wi-Fi and network setup, relocation and mounting.

expertise.title: Access control and related systems
expertise.text: Intercoms, digital door locks, access control and electric fences, subject to assessment.

mission: To understand each customer's real problem and deliver the right technical solution, with dependable service and lasting value, and to stand by our work after installation.
